name: CausticContagion / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A sticky fibrous tissue rip, two tiny acidic bubble pops and a compact papery spore puff. Wet caustic and dusty poisonous detachment, physically sharp onset.
